svg.title: Interpret the second equality first on compact momentum sets, where weights are bounded, then on all Borel sets by monotone exhaustion. This defines the possibly infinite undamped measure without applying an inverse heat operator to a Hilbert vector. Its horizontal measure is exactly μZ Θ = μΘ, with e−2sp0μZ Θ = μZ s , Z e−2sp0dμZ Θ = ∥vZ s ∥2 < ∞.
